proposed_from.topic: Exact finite causal-fiber characterization and below-completeness identification for hidden-recanting-witness mediation in the fixed finite Wu–Bai–Cui proxy-augmented SCM: for the bridge-supported WBC envelope with a three-state hidden recanting witness and binary proxies, represent every compatible full-law target value by a finite canonical response-type feasible set, define its sharp range Γ(P), characterize the unique maximal point-identification subclass by equality of the sharp endpoints, and give checkable two-SCM nonidentification certificates; derive a calibrated common-shock subclass whose latent-valid observed bridges identify the same-unit nested mean despite failure of three-state proxy completeness, prove the conditional row-span and proxy-measurable arm-zero rescue branches, supply exact positive rank-two success and positive-law failure artifacts, and prove sharp one-bit restoration of the two WBC completeness clauses for the fixed channel conditional on the remaining WBC premises and bridge existence; leave the positive-interior converse and root-n/efficiency theory open, with the NLSY97 high-school-track-to-wage interpretation.

Proximal ID retains latent injectivity at its ordinary or sequential proxy step and produces recursive interventional margins rather than this scalar cross-world target. BaiWuSunCui2026 instead treats an observed treatment-induced recanting witness distinct from a latent baseline confounder, identifies \\(\\mathbb E[Y(1,D(1),M(0,D(1)))]\\) through three bridges and three stage-specific completeness conditions, and does not cover the exact rank-deficient hidden-witness success member.","why_not_relabeling":"The inherited row-space equivalence is demoted. The graph and target differ essentially from BaiWuSunCui2026: its observed recanting witness is distinct from the latent confounder, whereas the present recanting witness is itself hidden and retained at the same unit-level treatment-zero realization. The result neither claims a complete identification characterization nor subsumes Bai--Wu--Sun--Cui or the recursive Proximal ID algorithm, and neither comparator subsumes this theorem.","settled_vs_open":"Calibrated-subclass identification, the broad conditional envelope, exact artifacts, and input-specific completeness restoration are theorem targets. seed_details.seed: one-SCM sharp set for the shared hidden witness
seed_details.anchor: WuBaiCui2026, Sections 2--3 and Theorem 3.1; DuarteFinkelsteinKnoxMummoloShpitser2024, Theorem 1
seed_details.proof_boundary: The complete-bridge proof substitutes latent conditional expectations after uniqueness; the first changed step is to retain one common response coordinate for both occurrences of \(H(0)\) and prove a two-way SCM--polynomial-fiber correspondence.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for hidden-recanting partial identification and shared-witness response-function bounds found no direct result.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Duarte et al. because every finite SCM query is a polynomial program.
seed_details.rebuttal: The generic reduction does not specify the Wu--Bai--Cui district factorization or prevent two independent copies of the recanting witness; the theorem must prove exact reconstruction of one compatible SCM.

seed_details.anchor: DonohoLiu1991, modulus theorem and composite-testing reduction; WuBaiCui2026, Theorem 4.3 root-n benchmark
seed_details.proof_boundary: Classical achievability uses a scalar functional over a convex class; the first changed step is to turn a common multinomial confidence fiber into an upper bound for a set-valued nonconvex optimum map and match it by a directed-Hausdorff two-law test.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches combining set-valued Hellinger modulus, partial identification, and causal polynomial fibers found adjacent random-set inference but no matching local-minimax result for this target.
seed_details.red_team: Donoho--Liu already says the Hellinger modulus determines the minimax rate.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their theorem does not cover honest confidence regions for a nonconvex set-valued parameter; both the fiber-image upper construction and the whole-set two-law lower reduction are new proof obligations.

seed_details.seed: terminating NPM-CERT endpoint and modulus solver
seed_details.anchor: DuarteFinkelsteinKnoxMummoloShpitser2024, Algorithm 2; Lasserre2001, Theorem 3.4; Nie2014, finite-convergence theorem
seed_details.proof_boundary: Autobounds treats one causal objective; the first changed step is an algebraic lift of Hellinger distance and a quantified coupled two-law program, with cylindrical algebraic decomposition as a singular-face termination backstop.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for causal bounds with Hellinger-modulus certification found general SOS branch-and-bound papers but no causal two-law certificate procedure.
seed_details.red_team: This is only an implementation of general quantifier elimination.
seed_details.rebuttal: The theorem delivers causal primal witnesses, proxy-rank and shared-response validity, coupled modulus certificates, and a stopping gap; generic elimination alone supplies none of this typed correspondence.

seed_details.anchor: SachsGabrielFay2024, exact multinomial inversion; RomanoShaikh2010, whole-set coverage criterion
seed_details.proof_boundary: Scalar target inversion must be replaced by one law-level fiber whose entire causal image is retained; the first changed step is proving that outward certified optimization commutes with the containment event at simplex faces.
seed_details.destination_search: No result located applies exact multinomial inversion to the full hidden-recanting SCM image.
seed_details.red_team: Coverage is the trivial event implication \(P\in\mathcal C_n\Rightarrow\Theta(P)\subseteq\widehat\Theta_n\).
seed_details.rebuttal: That implication is the backbone, but the substantive result couples exact boundary-uniform calibration with a computable nonconvex union and certified outward approximation; alone it is field-level and therefore paired with the modulus theorem.
seed_details.decision: merged into the surviving local-minimax seed rather than retained as a fourth standalone candidate

seed_details.anchor: WuBaiCui2026, Assumptions 3.2 and 3.4; MiaoGengTchetgen2018, finite rank condition
seed_details.proof_boundary: Full column rank makes every latent direction visible; the first changed step is to quotient the rank-deficient response fiber by directions annihilated by the scalar shared-witness query and characterize when the query is constant on every component.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for scalar target identification under rank-deficient proximal operators found sufficient completeness results but no hidden-recanting iff frontier.
seed_details.red_team: Singleton identification is equivalent by definition to \(L(P)=U(P)\).
seed_details.rebuttal: A publishable version requires an observable algebraic criterion independent of solving both global endpoint programs; that criterion is not yet in hand.
seed_details.decision: dropped after deep scan because the non-tautological observable criterion lacks a verified handle

seed_details.anchor: GhassamiShpitserTchetgen2023, incomplete-proxy bounds; prior proposal scm_prox_recant_pid, reviewer request for a rational positive witness
seed_details.proof_boundary: The simpler hidden-mediator construction does not preserve a shared recanting response; the first changed step is to exclude a matched no-proxy endpoint face while all observed cells remain positive and both channels have rank exactly two.
seed_details.destination_search: No positive open-class construction was found for the Wu--Bai--Cui target.
seed_details.red_team: A single engineered numerical witness has no theorem value.
seed_details.rebuttal: The seed requires rational exact certificates and a positive separation margin that persists on a relatively open feasible-law neighborhood.
seed_details.decision: merged into the surviving one-SCM sharpness seed as its nonvacuity theorem

seed_details.anchor: Robinson1976, nonlinear stability condition; DonohoLiu1991, local modulus rate
seed_details.proof_boundary: Robinson regularity gives a Lipschitz error bound, but rank loss can create semialgebraic cusps; the first changed step is to compute target-restricted coderivatives and curve-selection exponents for endpoint optimizer strata.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for Robinson regularity of causal identified sets and semialgebraic Hellinger moduli found constraint-qualification surveys but no target-specific exponent theorem.
seed_details.red_team: Semialgebraic maps are Hölder by standard \L{}ojasiewicz theory.
seed_details.rebuttal: Existence of some exponent neither identifies the sharp exponent nor connects it to honest causal-set inference or a checkable Robinson frontier.
seed_details.decision: merged into the surviving local-minimax seed as its first-class open-ended question

seed_details.anchor: MiaoGengTchetgen2018, matrix-rank identification; WuBaiCui2026, discrete completeness dimension discussion
seed_details.proof_boundary: The sufficient dimension count must be replaced by a target-specific design criterion; the first changed step is to optimize an added proxy partition so that the shared-witness query becomes constant without requiring full latent-law recovery.
seed_details.destination_search: Proxy-experiment-design papers address graph-query identification but not this hidden-recanting bridge geometry.

seed_details.seed: critical-delta sensitivity to proxy exclusion violations
seed_details.anchor: WuBaiCui2026, Assumption 3.1 proxy exclusions; GhassamiShpitserTchetgen2023, proxy-compatible bounds
seed_details.proof_boundary: Exact proxy separation is replaced by bounded conditional-dependence residuals; the first changed step is to encode the violation budget polynomially and derive the smallest \(\delta\) at which a sign or strict-contraction conclusion changes.
seed_details.destination_search: The search found regression-based sensitivity analyses for other proximal models but no critical-delta bound for a shared hidden recanting witness.
seed_details.red_team: Any bound can be widened mechanically by relaxing its constraints.
seed_details.rebuttal: The critical value and sharp sensitivity path would be nontrivial, but the required scientifically calibrated violation metric is not specified by the present topic.
seed_details.decision: dropped because the violation metric would be author-invented rather than anchored

proposed_from.literature_map: WuBaiCui2026 is the exact graph-and-target anchor: its Sections 2--3 define the shared \(H(0)\) nested mean and its bridge theorems identify it under completeness, while its discussion and NLSY97 application motivate the destination. MiaoGengTchetgen2018 supplies the finite matrix-rank interpretation of proxy completeness. GhassamiShpitserTchetgen2023 supplies incomplete-proxy partial identification for treatment and hidden-mediator targets, but not the shared hidden-recanting functional. DuarteFinkelsteinKnoxMummoloShpitser2024 supplies the response-function polynomial equivalence and epsilon-sharp computation template. Lasserre2001 and Nie2014 supply moment--SOS convergence and generic finite-convergence conditions; exact cylindrical algebraic decomposition is added here to cover singular termination. SachsGabrielFay2024 supplies exact multinomial inversion, while RomanoShaikh2010 and KaidoMolinariStoye2019 distinguish whole-set coverage from inference on selected values and connect constraint geometry to partial identification. DonohoLiu1991, ArmstrongKolesar2018, and PolyanskiyWu2026 supply modulus and two-law testing architectures. Robinson1973 supplies computable nonlinear-program error bounds, and Robinson1976 supplies the explicit differentiable-system stability condition. Searches through the anchor citations and exact target--method phrases found no paper that subsumes the one-SCM shared-witness sharpness, certified coupled modulus, and matching whole-set local-minimax inference kernel.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 2: wbc-target-span-identification
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The envelope assumes nonempty latent-valid/observed bridge intersection and the two target-relevant latent transport-overlap restrictions.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Conditional identification over the explicitly defined bridge-supported WBC class; it is not an observable or primitive completeness frontier.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 1: calibrated-target-span-identification
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The calibrated common-shock construction derives bridge realizability but conditions on, rather than derives, both latent transport-overlap restrictions.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Below-completeness identification conditional on those two non-testable support restrictions.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 3: minimal-binary-augmentation
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Full augmented-channel rank restores only the displayed completeness clauses and does not establish bridge existence or the remaining Wu--Bai--Cui premises.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Sharp one-bit completeness restoration for the fixed channel, with WBC identification only under the additional cited premises.

banked_reason: Sound subfield identification result, but the broad envelope retains non-testable latent bridge and transport restrictions, the positive-interior converse remains open, and no certified endpoint or inference frontier reaches field tier.
